title: Dutch startup trials smart bike rack that charges and locks e-bikes
summary: A pilot with a smart bike rack called the Lock and Load, which automatically locks and charges an e-bike, has begun at the University of Twente.

title: EU delays ETIAS launch until 2027 due to EES border chaos
summary: The rollout of the European Travel Information and Authorisation System (ETIAS) for the EU has been delayed until 2027. Here’s what passengers need to know.

title: Arriva plans new international train service connecting Dutch cities with Paris
summary: The UK-based transport company Arriva has announced plans to run new daily train services connecting Paris with multiple Dutch cities from 2028.

title: Rare giant penis plant in bloom at Rotterdam zoo for first time in 3 years
summary: The rare titan arum, also known as the giant penis plant, has bloomed at the Victoria Greenhouse at Blijdorp Zoo for the first time in 3 years.

title: Summer delays expected at airports as EU rejects calls to pause EES
summary: Airports are braced for delays during the busy summer period as the European Union (EU) has refused to hit pause on the new Entry/Exit System (EES).

title: All Dutch public transport will be free for children from 2027
summary: From 2027, children across the Netherlands can travel on public transport for free. To fund this scheme the travel discount for over-65s will be scrapped.

title: Job sectors in the Netherlands with the most vacation days
summary: The job sectors in the Netherlands with the highest average number of vacation days have been revealed by AD, from education to construction.

title: Nationwide fireworks ban in the Netherlands comes into effect in August
summary: From August 1, 2026, Dutch residents will not be allowed to set off consumer fireworks as the nationwide fireworks ban comes into effect.

title: Starting housing co-ops to become easier with new Dutch law
summary: The House of Representatives has approved a new law that would make it easier for a group of residents to start a housing cooperative in the Netherlands.

title: Dutch government to refund 9 million euros for wrongly issued integration fines
summary: Residents fined for failing to pass their Dutch integration exams on time are set to receive refunds. The government will pay out a total of 9 million euros.

title: Another heatwave on the cards for the Netherlands as temps top 30C this week
summary: Another heatwave could be in store for the Netherlands this week. Temperatures are once again expected to rise above 30 degrees celsius.

title: Summer roadworks on A1 towards Amsterdam adds up to hour to driver travel time
summary: As of July 3, major roadworks on the A1 towards Amsterdam have started, causing travel delays of up to an hour until the works are complete on August 17.

title: Average Dutch wealth hits $415K in new 2026 UBS report
summary: The Netherlands has been ranked among the richest countries, according to the 2026 UBS Wealth Report, which placed it 10th by average wealth per person.
